source_text: Fragmenta varia 88 Τὸ μὴ μόνον ἄνθρωπον, ἀλλὰ καὶ Θεόν, καθὼς καὶ Ἱερεμίας ὁ προφήτης λέγει· οὗτος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, οὐ λογισθήσεται ἕτερος πρὸς αὐτόν.
thought_title: Not only human but also God
orientation: Eustathius opens a fragment by stating the claim he will defend: the one who appeared on earth is not only human but also God, as Jeremiah the prophet says.
pass_a_gloss: The claim that he is not only a human being, but also God, just as Jeremiah the prophet also says: this is our God; no other will be reckoned beside him.

choices.term: Τὸ μὴ μόνον ἄνθρωπον, ἀλλὰ καὶ Θεόν
choices.english: The claim that he is not only a human being, but also God
choices.why: The articular infinitive phrase states the thesis; supplying 'the claim that he is' makes the fragment's opening assertion clear in English while preserving the contrast between human being and God.
rejected: Not only a human being, but also God
That he is not only human, but also God

choices.english: no other will be reckoned beside him
choices.why: The future passive of λογίζομαι with πρὸς αὐτόν means no other will be counted or reckoned in comparison to him; 'beside him' preserves the comparative force of πρὸς αὐτόν.
rejected: no other will be counted against him
no other will be considered with him

choices.term: καθὼς καὶ Ἱερεμίας ὁ προφήτης λέγει
choices.english: just as Jeremiah the prophet also says
choices.why: The καὶ after καθὼς adds emphasis ('also says'); rendering it as 'also' preserves the author's appeal to the prophet as an additional witness.
rejected: even as Jeremiah the prophet says

bible_refs.note: οὗτος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, οὐ λογισθήσεται ἕτερος πρὸς αὐτόν

pass_b_english: The one who appeared on earth and lived among human beings is not only a human being but also God, just as Jeremiah the prophet also says: “This is our God; no other will be reckoned beside him” (Jeremiah).

problems.why: Source attributes quote to Jeremiah, not Baruch.
problems.ruling: Source says Ἱερεμίας ὁ προφήτης (Jeremiah the prophet); adding 'Baruch 3:36' misleads reader on attribution.

problems.why: Same prophet called full title then just 'Jeremiah'

problems.quote: "This is our God; no other will be reckoned beside him" (Jeremiah)
problems.why: Cited as 'Jeremiah' but is Baruch 3:35-36, not canonical Jeremiah
problems.fix: Correct to Baruch 3:35-36 or explain Jeremiah attribution
